items.note: The PRD never says the product is a B2B note-taking app. Section 2 lists 'what the product is' and 'who the users are' as gaps for the author to fill in, so information the person supplied is missing.

It is framed as a 'Draft for kickoff review' and repeatedly hands items to the engineering and design leads to flag or decide. The 'Decision requested: whether to build' line is a little odd for a kickoff, but the audience is right.
The scope table and requirements R1–R8 cover workspace creation, inviting members by email and shared notes.
R9 and R10 set exactly two roles, admin and member, with no others in v1.
Billing changes, SSO and guest access are each listed as explicitly out of scope.
Section 8 states the primary metric exactly: 20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days.
The document has ten sections, several tables, a long proposed-metrics list and a repeated gaps/assumptions appendix. That is well over about 2 pages, likely 4–5.
Migration is open question 1, marked undecided, with no option recommended. It lists illustrative options and things to weigh.
